summary: Retest of the 4-criterion briefing (status-label bug fix, PDF single-page/no-remarks, login credential confirmation, filter tabs off internal bucket). All 8 pre-existing backend tests + 8 pre-existing browser checks from iteration_2 re-ran clean (one stale assertion in vendor-data-real-mapping expecting the old generic 'Under Finance Review' wording was updated to the new real wording per the spec_deviations note). Added 1 new backend test file (2 new test cases + 1 auth-failure case) for status_label + PDF page-count/size/text content, and 3 new browser checks: bill-status-label-real-wording (dashboard/bills/admin all show the real wording), bill-status-filter-tabs-use-internal-bucket (filter tabs still key off the internal bucket), and vendor-login-via-public-url (login through the public APP_URL ingress). No bugs found; everything matches the acceptance matrix and spec_deviations exactly.
